items.rationale: The whole earlier list is sent again, plus the new tool request and result: 4,000 + 100 + 500 = 4,600. An answer of 600 counts only the new content and forgets that the earlier content is resent on every call.

A new session starts with an empty message list and the model keeps nothing between calls, so the program must save notes and load them into the new session. Options a, b and d assume the model or the window carries memory across sessions.

A training status is a safety fact, so it is decided from the authoritative record read through a tool at the moment of the decision. A saved note is a possibly stale copy, the student's claim is a belief, and the model's judgment is a guess; none of them can decide it.

items.rationale: Every call rereads the whole message list, so a pasted manual is billed on every call. Retrieval puts only the few best chunks in the window. A response that gives only the larger-window argument, or only says retrieval is more accurate, misses the cost reason.
